Your quote for the 3 doors is ready: https://handyservices.app/quote/rs001

candidate.body: Got the six photos, thanks. So that's all nine doors, hinges and handles, upstairs and down. I'll get a fresh quote over to you.

cases.provenance: 4 Sep 2026 (Sarah, 4c0e227b, scrubbed): a £569 quote for 3 doors, back for all 9 with six photos. Haiku triage returned out_of_scope and flagged Ben with no reply. A scope increase is scoping: tag rescope + needs_quote, the clerk redoes the quote.
